name: Workspace Monitoring Sample Experience
description: As part of our collaboration with the Power BI team and the OneLake Catalog, we’re excited to introduce new features in both the semantic model details page and the Power BI report page to raise awareness around the new monitoring experience.To support learning and adoption, we’re also developing a hands-on sample that serves as both on-the-job training and a reusable template. This sample will walk users through the types of data available once monitoring is enabled and demonstrate how to fully leverage the Fabric RTI toolset.Key capabilities include:Visualizing monitoring data through dashboards and reportsTriggering actions and notifications using ActivatorTogether, these enhancements and the guided sample experience aim to increase visibility and encourage more Power BI users to adopt workspace monitoring and engage deeply with Fabric RTI features.
